description: ignorePaths restates the :ignoreModulesAndTests default (part of config:recommended) minus '**/tests/**': the postgres custom manager below must see backend/tests/fixtures/db_provider.py, which the default ignore silently excludes.

One dependency, one PR: bumps are deliberately NOT batched into weekly grouped PRs. This repo is public and every CI job runs on a standard GitHub-hosted runner, which GitHub does not meter (https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions), so grouping bought nothing but cost atomicity: a grouped branch passes or fails as a whole, Renovate cannot split it, and one bad bump then holds back every other update in the batch ('grouping dependencies increases the chance that the branch has an error' — https://docs.renovatebot.com/noise-reduction/). Per-package PRs give one revertable commit per dependency instead. The shared-pin groups below are the exception, and they exist for correctness — every site of one pin must move together — not to save minutes.

customManagers:dockerfileVersions reads `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` annotations above `ENV`/`ARG` *_VERSION lines in Dockerfiles — the built-in dockerfile manager sees FROM lines only. Preferred over a hand-rolled regex manager per https://docs.renovatebot.com/modules/manager/regex/ ('you only need one customManager instead of four', and the annotation documents the pin where a reader of the Dockerfile will see it). Currently one site: PNPM_VERSION in frontend/Dockerfile. The preset only matches annotated lines, so it cannot pick anything up by accident.

osvVulnerabilityAlerts adds OSV-sourced CVE detection for direct dependencies on top of GitHub's own alerts, so a vulnerable backend package is caught even where the Dependabot dependency graph does not read uv.lock. Security fixes need no further wiring: Renovate's vulnerabilityAlerts defaults already override the weekly schedule and the minimumReleaseAge cooldown below (schedule [], minimumReleaseAge null, prCreation 'immediate').

Concurrency, rebasing and platform automerge are left at Renovate's defaults (prConcurrentLimit 10, prHourlyLimit 2, rebaseWhen 'auto', platformAutomerge true), which suit unmetered CI. 'auto' resolves to 'behind-base-branch' on a branch with automerge enabled, so an automerged commit was green against current main rather than against a stale base.

packageRules.description: This is an application (frontend is private, backend is a deployed service — neither is published for others to install), so Renovate best practice is to pin runtime deps to exact versions rather than float SemVer ranges (https://docs.renovatebot.com/dependency-pinning/). :pinDevDependencies already pins frontend devDependencies; this rule extends exact pinning to the frontend runtime 'dependencies' that still carry '^' ranges. Scoped to frontend/package.json so it does not rewrite the backend's '>=' floors, which intentionally rely on uv.lock as the real pin. The global rangeStrategy stays 'bump'.
Auto-merge dev tooling (linters, formatters, type checkers, test libs) on minor/patch — these break loudly in CI, not silently in prod.

Carve-out from the rule above: SvelteKit convention puts the framework, bundler, CSS engine and component library in devDependencies, but their output ships in the bundle, so 'breaks loudly in CI' does not hold for them — a Tailwind or Flowbite minor can move the layout, and an icon-pack minor can redraw a glyph, with every gate green. These get a review PR like any other shipped dependency. Everything else in devDependencies (eslint, prettier, typescript, svelte-check, vitest, openapi-typescript) keeps automerging.

Auto-merge backend dev-group tools (ruff, ty, pytest, import-linter, etc.) on minor/patch. The depType is 'dependency-groups' — the name Renovate's pep621 manager gives the whole PEP 735 [dependency-groups] table (https://docs.renovatebot.com/modules/manager/pep621/) — not the group's own name 'dev', which never matched.

Auto-merge GitHub Actions on minor/patch; majors still get a manual review PR. 'digest' and 'pin' ride along because helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests re-pins by digest constantly, and pinning an action already in use to its current digest changes nothing.
Auto-merge pre-commit hook bumps on minor/patch.

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): keep every uv pin identical. Groups the PyPI pin (setup.sh, pyproject [tool.uv]), the setup-uv 'version' input in CI that the github-actions manager reads as 'astral-sh/uv', the Docker builder image, and the mise toolchain pin into one PR so they always bump together. uv_build rides along: Astral releases it from the same repo under the same version numbers, so with rangeStrategy 'bump' its floor in [build-system] requires would otherwise move in a PR of its own and leave the two disagreeing.

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): keep every Postgres image pin identical (docker-compose + the two Python literals) — a mismatched image risks false migration diffs. One grouped PR. postgres-backup-local's '18-alpine' tag must track the postgres major, so it rides in the same group.
Group Node runtime pins (mise, frontend Dockerfile, the setup-node 'node-version' input in CI) so the runtime version bumps in a single reviewable PR.

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): keep every Python pin identical. Three managers see three different files — mise.toml (mise), backend/.python-version (pyenv) and requires-python in backend/pyproject.toml (pep621) — each with its own datasource, so without this group one Python release arrives as three PRs that can settle on different versions.

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): keep every pnpm binary pin identical — mise.toml, package.json 'packageManager', and the 'version' input to pnpm/action-setup in CI, which the github-actions manager extracts natively as 'pnpm'. One grouped PR. Matching by depName excludes the pnpm/action-setup action itself, a separate version stream.

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): keep the hadolint binary pin identical across the pre-commit hook (.pre-commit-config.yaml rev) and mise.toml. Excludes hadolint/hadolint-action, a separate action version stream.
Major runtime/image and framework bumps are review-only: no automerge, explicit label so they surface on the dashboard.

customManagers.description: Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): Postgres image tag hard-coded as a Python string literal in the migration generator and the integration-test fixture (not visible to the docker-compose manager).

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): hadolint image tag in the cloud setup script — both the prepull list and the Docker-backed shim it installs (hadolint has no native install channel in that environment). Feeds the 'hadolint' group above so it bumps together with mise.toml and the .pre-commit-config.yaml rev.

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): uv version pinned as a PyPI package in the cloud setup script and in pyproject [tool.uv] required-version. The CI setup-uv input needs no manager here — the github-actions manager reads supported 'uses ... with' version inputs itself (https://docs.renovatebot.com/modules/manager/github-actions/) and reports that line as 'astral-sh/uv', which the uv group above matches. Same for the pnpm input to pnpm/action-setup ('pnpm') and node-version to setup-node ('node').

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): pnpm installed via `npm install -g pnpm@X.Y.Z` in the cloud setup script. This is a functional pin — the session runs this pnpm — unlike the postgres/valkey prepull literals in the same file, which are cache hints backed by the real pins in docker-compose.yml and the test fixtures. No built-in manager reads a shell script, so without this manager the line stays invisible to Renovate and drifts behind the other pnpm sites. Feeds the 'pnpm' group above via depName 'pnpm'.
